a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards.
Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, this Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ and ＜Piercing＞ for the turn.
